description: Owner-controlled revocation registry for provider builds (APPROVED_PROVIDER_BUILD_AND_EXECUTION_BOUNDARY_V1). Read by provider_build_manifest.load_revocation_registry at every launch and by vnstock_worker_client at every controlled boundary (spawn and each request). To revoke: raise current_epoch and/or set builds.<build_id> = {"state": "REVOKED", "epoch": <n>, "reason": ..., "revoked_at_utc": ..., "decision_id": ...} and/or list the manifest's canonical SHA-256 in revoked_manifest_sha256. A revoked or stale-epoch build cannot start, and an active worker fails at its next request with its process killed and reaped. A missing or invalid registry refuses every launch. No build is approved, so nothing is listed.
